explication: FusionPBX is a web-based, multi-tenant PBX and telephony administration platform built around FreeSWITCH. Administrators configure telephony features; devices can then request generated provisioning files, while operators use live call-management applications. The README documents broad PBX capabilities, but most feature implementation files were not sampled, so their internal call relationships are not asserted. The provisioning route and its rendering step are visible in excerpts; links from generated provisioning output to the switch are shown as unverified.
